title: SG-8.4.1 Single-writer history status in ContributionSheet
summary: Re-implement ContributionSheet history status as one change by a single writer
description: Context: ContributionSheet (game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx) loads history with listMine in a useEffect (L44-L66) and swallows failures silently. There is no history status. Desired behavior: one 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error' type, written only by the history effect, a reload counter in that effect's deps, and a guard against updates after the effect is cancelled. Expected result: the history list shows loading, ready or error deterministically and never updates after close, round change or unmount. Why: robust, visible history loading (SG-8.4).
acceptance_criteria: Given the sheet opens with a round id, When listMine is pending, Then a loading message is visible
Given listMine rejects, When the sheet is open, Then an error message and a Retry button are visible
Given Retry is clicked, When listMine is called again, Then status returns to loading and then ready on success
Given the sheet closes or roundId changes before listMine settles, When the promise settles, Then no state is updated

in_scope: HistoryStatus type, status state, reload counter and cancel guard in ContributionSheet
preserve: Submit, validation, quota and feedback behavior
Merge of history with entries sent while loading

technical_constraints: Only the history effect may write the history status
Use the existing listMine API from ../api/client
definition_of_done: All three requirements delivered with Act and Verify units green
